answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the umber of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, diluted when peers disagree. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The vertex lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the nebula is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
